profile.headline: AI Education Engineer | n8n Ambassador | 2026 AAIF Ambassador | Agentic Learning Systems & Automation | Full-Stack (React/Next.js) | Founder, MujerTech & ComadreLab.dev
profile.jobTitle: Founder & Independent Software Engineer (Websites + AI Automations)
profile.summary:
As an AI Education Engineer, I bridge the gap between complex engineering workflows and learner success by building adaptive, scalable training systems.  My unique advantage is a deep foundation in Software Engineering (React, Node.js, Python) combined with specialized training in E-Learning Instructional Design from the University of Washington. This allows me to speak the language of developers while engineering educational environments that actually stick.

My focus areas include:

* AI-Native Learning Architectures: I explore the intersection of Agentic AI and pedagogy through projects like MujerTech and Fluenta, building context-driven technical on-ramps that lower the barrier to entry for underrepresented groups.
* Technical Translation & Systems Design: I specialize in converting high-level engineering specs into modular, "agent-ready" curriculum paths for full-stack and cloud environments.
* The "Accountability Moat": I act as the technical "trust layer" in automated environments, ensuring that curriculum and AI-assisted feedback maintain pedagogical integrity and technical accuracy. 
* Workflow Automation: I leverage tools like LangChain, FastAPI, and Azure AI to build production-ready learning tools (like SazónBot) that turn static documentation into interactive tutorials.

I am driven by the challenge of building "zero-to-one" educational programs for emerging technologies. If your team is scaling fast and needs an engineer who can bridge the gap between code and the classroom, let’s talk.

positions.title: Founder & Independent Software Engineer (Websites + AI Automations)
positions.description:
Builds production-ready websites and web apps using modern JavaScript/React/Next.js with an emphasis on performance, accessibility, and maintainable code

 

Designs AI-assisted automation workflows and integrations across common business tools to streamline operations and reduce repetitive tasks

 

Documents solutions through clear technical writing, tutorials, and client-friendly guides so teams can maintain what’s shipped
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Business Process Analysis · Business Process Automation

positions.title: Technical Curriculum Developer
positions.description:
As a Technical Curriculum Developer at ELM Learning, I collaborated with stakeholders to define learning objectives and outcomes, transforming content into engaging courses. 

• Developed design documents with recommended visuals and interactions.
• Created scenario-based assessment questions and narrative scripts.
• Collaborated with the design and development team on custom/advanced interactions.
* Collaborated to developing content for Rise and Storyline authoring tools
positions.insights: Skills: E-Learning Development · Computer Software Training

positions.title: Technical Project Manager
positions.description:
Organizing events (this includes messaging on Eventbrite and via email, calendar invitations, photographers, locations, etc.): one-day workshops, application workshops, study sessions, onboarding day, launch celebrations, speakers, interviewing practice, career speakers, graduations, hackathons
Recruiting, applications, acceptance, and onboarding process
Outreach to, recruiting, and scheduling of volunteers
Sharing participants’ social media posts and posting program updates
Documenting program processes
Reporting to and assisting with all the pair programming sessions during the program
Updating the website
Building program software
Overseeing the application process

positions.title: Lead Technical Instructor and Technical Curriculum  Developer
positions.description:
Manage Techtonica’s application process (JavaScript pre-req study groups, application forms, JavaScript workshops, code challenges, interviews, and scheduling of board interviews), incrementing the qualified participation by 89%. 
Develop and update software for the program. 
Develop workshops to teach Javascript in the backend with Node.js, and in the frontend with React.js to Techtonica's participants and beginners from different organizations. 
Proposal and organize hackathons for the program.
